views: view1: แปลนฐานราก ตอม่อ 1:125 — footings F1/F2/F3 + columns C1/C2 (this split: footing_plan)
view2: same drawing — the single ground beam GB under the stair (this split: beam_plan)
warnings: Every column position prints a footing/column pair stacked beside the pedestal ('F2 / C1', 'F1 / C1', 'F3 / C2'): 21 positions = 9 F2/C1 on row A + 9 F1/C1 on row B + 3 F3/C2 on the stair-foot row C' (grids 3, 4, 5). Row C (corridor edge) has no footing — the corridor cantilevers from row B (B6' on S-02).

Row C' carries no grid bubble on this sheet; its 3.60 below row B equals C + 1.60 on S-02/A-03 (see the grid master). The C2 columns at C'3 and C'4 carry the stair landing (B5/B2 on S-02); C'5 is the stair foot where the plan draws the GB beam and the walkway slab.

Plan also shows 'พื้นทางเท้า ค.ส.ล.' (unmarked concrete walkway slab at the stair foot, 1.00 right of grid 5) and the hatched stair start between grids 4 and 5 — no mark and no spec on this sheet, not recorded as elements.

Footing details F1 (1.30 x 1.80, 12 piles) and F2 (1.30 x 1.30, 9 piles) are on S-05, F3 (1.00 x 1.00, 5 piles) on S-06; columns C1 0.25x0.25 (footing to roof) and C2 0.20x0.20 (footing to corridor level) on S-05.
